m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: You look cold and wet! Come, warm up in my embrace!
Feh! Take the Sultry Breeze! I hope you get dust in your eye!
Hear my thunder! Feel the flash and crackle of my lightning! Tremble in your bones!
I'll never amount to a real storm!
You think I was a pretty good tempest? That's kind of you to say. Please, take this Storm-Tossed Gale and use it well.
I'll reach into your lungs and freeze your breath away!
Aye aye aye aye aye! Here is the Chill Blast!
You've acquired an excellent collection of winds! Now you've got everything you need.
In order to lift, carry, and push your Cloud-Sailing Raft, you'll need some wind, yes?
There are three caverns beneath the Tree of Secrets in Saltmeadow Marsh. Each is home to a Lesser Wind Spirit.
Duel the Fuego Spirit for a Sultry Breeze; the Tempestad Spirit for a Storm-Tossed Gale; and the Hielo Spirit for a Chill Blast.
Don't lose the winds you catch. Bring them all back here.
Find the caverns beneath the Tree of Secrets in Saltmeadow Marsh. Battle the Fuego, Tempestad, and Hielo Spirits.
Bring back the winds you catch as your reward.
